join: normalised caniuse title = normalised web-features name (candidate)
method: 20 pairs drawn with random.Random(20261118) from the 192 title matches in webf_measure.json (joins.caniuse_title_candidate.handcheck_pairs); each pair judged by reading both records' descriptions, specification URLs and first Chrome version

pairs.reason: same HTML canvas element (WHATWG HTML canvas section on both); caniuse counts from Chrome 4, its earliest tracked version, web-features says 1; no declared link exists for this caniuse id
same MessageChannel feature, same WHATWG section anchor, Chrome 4 on both
same Web NFC API (web-nfc spec), no Chrome desktop support on both
same text-orientation property, css-writing-modes spec, Chrome 48 on both
same dialog element, WHATWG HTML dialog section, Chrome 37 on both
same Service Worker spec URL, Chrome 45 on both

pairs.web_features_entry: Small, large, and dynamic viewport units
pairs.reason: same sv*/lv*/dv* units, css-values-4 #viewport-variants, Chrome 108 on both
same font-feature-settings property (css-fonts); caniuse counts prefixed support from Chrome 21, web-features unprefixed from 48
same Touch Events spec, Chrome 22 on both
same Vibration API spec (navigator.vibrate); Chrome 30 vs 32, no declared link exists for this caniuse id
different features: caniuse is the CSS element() image function (no Chrome support), web-features is the @function at-rule (Chrome 139, css-mixins spec); the normaliser dropped 'css' and 'element'
same property, css-fonts #font-variant-numeric, Chrome 52 on both
same overflow-wrap / word-wrap property, css-text spec, Chrome 23 on both

related but not the same record: caniuse is the CSS.supports() script method (Chrome 61), web-features is the @supports at-rule (Chrome 28); web-features declares css-supports-api for its css-supports feature instead
same Web Serial API (navigator.serial), Chrome 89 on both
identical WHATWG spec anchor (shadowrootmode), Chrome 111 on both
same SVG filter element feature (filter effects); Chrome 8 vs 5
same box-decoration-break property, css-break spec, Chrome 130 on both
same deprecated WebVR API, never shipped in Chrome on both
same letter-spacing property; caniuse Chrome 30 vs web-features 1 (caniuse counts full support later)
